result.summary: Implemented Letflow.Engine.cancel_instance/3 in lib/letflow/engine.ex exactly per lib/letflow/design/req052-instance-cancellation.md's Multi table (M1 open_tasks lock -> M2 instance_projection lock -> M3 eligibility via InstanceProjection.terminal?/1 (reused unchanged) -> M4 task cancellations via Task.complete_changeset/2 (reused unchanged) -> M5 live-token lock+cancel via TokenRecord.advance_changeset/2 (reused unchanged) -> M6 INSTANCE_CANCELLED event append (before M7, so EventStore.append/2's own active_instance_guard/3 does not self-reject on a status this Multi already wrote) -> M7 instance_projections status write via InstanceProjection.update_changeset/2). tasks locked before instance_projections, matching complete_task/3's global lock-ordering rule. @spec/error taxonomy (cancel_attrs/cancel_opts/cancel_error/cancel_result) copied verbatim from design doc §3. Added the required moduledoc content (SUPERSESSION disposition + SCH-03/REQ-056 scope boundary) to Letflow.Engine's top moduledoc, matching the existing create/2 and complete_task/3 sections' style. Deleted lib/letflow/parallel_approval.ex and lib/letflow/approval_supervisor.ex per design doc SS2 (DELETE, no retained half), removed Letflow.ApprovalSupervisor's child-spec entry from lib/letflow/application.ex, and updated lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex's moduledoc to remove the now-stale ApprovalSupervisor cross-reference (design doc SS2 point 3). No migration added -- every column this design writes to (tasks.cancelled_at, tokens.cancelled_at, instance_projections.cancelled_at, all *.status:cancelled) already exists per REQ-023/043's shipped schemas, confirmed by design doc SS8. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` output: 'Compiling 1 file (.ex)\nGenerated letflow app' (clean, 0 warnings). `mix format --check-formatted` clean for every file this run touched (engine.ex, application.ex, sandbox_pool.ex) after one `mix format` pass on engine.ex; the three other files mix format flags (graph.ex, identity_migration.ex, event_store_test.exs, sandbox_pool_test.exs) are pre-existing unformatted files this run did not touch, left as-is. Full `mix test` run: '3 properties, 883 tests, 0 failures' (includes the 32 pre-existing test/letflow/engine_test.exs tests for create/2 and complete_task/3, still passing unchanged -- no test yet exercises cancel_instance/3 itself, that is TEST-DESIGNER's job next).

issues.note: Deleted test/letflow/parallel_approval_test.exs alongside its now-deleted subject modules (lib/letflow/parallel_approval.ex, lib/letflow/approval_supervisor.ex), per design doc SS2's explicit instruction. Its coverage (two-approver gen_statem sign-off, supervisor crash isolation) is not migrated/re-created anywhere -- TEST-DESIGNER does not need to re-migrate it (the module it tested no longer exists), this is only a note that it's gone, not an open coverage gap for REQ-052's own acceptance criteria.

Design doc leaves six open questions (OQ-1..OQ-6, SS11) unresolved and explicitly flagged for REVIEWER/RELEASE-VALIDATOR, most notably OQ-2 (MAJOR) on whether cancel_instance/3's 'agreement by construction' answer to the join-path-vs-direct-cancel AC is the intended reading. This implementation follows the design doc's resolution as written without deviation; routing to REVIEWER surfaces these for sign-off, not silently resolved by ELIXIR-DEV.
